decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing combo pieces like Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Grinding Station, and Underworld Breach to quickly assemble a win condition and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By recurring artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal with Emry's ability and using Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for card advantage, the deck aims to set up a powerful combo turn that can win the game in a single explosive sequence. This deck is all about assembling the right pieces and executing a game-winning combo at the right moment.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with a variety of counterspells, removal, and creature control. By using cards like Force of Negation, Counterspell, and Fatal Push, it aims to control the board and prevent the opponent from establishing a strong presence. The deck also leverages graveyard manipulation with cards like Psychic Frog and Graveyard Trespasser to further hinder the opponent's game plan. Additionally, cards like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus provide strong win conditions while maintaining control over the game.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game through counterspells and removal spells, while utilizing cards like Thought Scour and Consider to filter through the deck and dig for key pieces. Murktide Regent serves as a powerful finisher, while Psychic Frog and Abhorrent Oculus provide additional control elements. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and slowly grind them out with efficient removal and card advantage. The land base includes a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent mana development. Overall, the deck focuses on denying the opponent resources and maintaining control of the game.

The deck utilizes cards that mill the opponent's library, such as Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Fractured Sanity, while also disrupting their strategy with countermagic and removal spells like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push. Tasha's Hideous Laughter is used to exile cards from the opponent's graveyard, reducing their resources. The deck aims to deplete the opponent's library quickly, making them draw from an empty deck and lose the game. It also has ways to search for key cards like Archive Trap and Glimpse the Unthinkable to accelerate the milling process.

This deck focuses on using Underworld Breach along with Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Grinding Station to combo off and mill the opponent's deck. It utilizes artifacts and cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal to generate mana and trigger abilities. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps filter through the deck and find key pieces while Malevolent Rumble and Unholy Heat provide removal and control. The goal is to set up the combo quickly while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Spell Snare and removal spells like Engineered Explosives.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to generate value and win the game quickly. By filling the graveyard with key cards such as Malevolent Rumble and Grapeshot, the deck can continuously cast spells from the graveyard using Underworld Breach to create a lethal storm of spells. Cards like Wrenn and Six help to recur lands and Mox Opal to ramp up mana quickly. The deck also includes disruption in the form of interaction and removal spells like Unholy Heat and Soul-Guide Lantern to disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble a combination of cards that allow for a powerful win condition without relying on traditional land cards. By utilizing countermagic, card draw, and artifact-based mana sources, the goal is to quickly and efficiently deploy cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Thundertrap Trainer to deal lethal damage to the opponent. With a focus on generating mana and disrupting the opponent's game plan, this deck aims to be proactive and aggressive in a unique way within the Modern format.

The main concept of this Merfolk aggro deck is to establish a fast and aggressive board presence using powerful Merfolk creatures like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident, supported by cards like Aether Vial and Mutavault. Cards like Merfolk Trickster and Harbinger of the Seas provide disruption for the opponent's strategies, while Force of Negation offers protection. Spreading Seas and Tide Shaper help control the opponent's mana base, while Svyelun of Sea and Sky offers card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently with a strong Merfolk tribal theme.

The deck is focused on using Underworld Breach and Grinding Station to combo off and win the game quickly. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Mishra's Bauble help to set up the combo by recycling cards from the graveyard. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Soul-Guide Lantern and Unholy Heat to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent before they can respond. It also incorporates some artifact synergy with Mox Opal and Urza's Saga to generate additional value.

The deck focuses on utilizing lands and ramping effects to quickly assemble the Amulet of Vigor combo with Primeval Titan, allowing for explosive turns and powerful land toolbox interactions. By utilizing cards like Explore, Green Sun's Zenith, and Gruul Turf, the deck aims to ramp into powerful lands such as Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva, while controlling the board with cards like Aftermath Analyst and Spelunking. The deck also includes key utility lands like Tolaria West and Cultivator Colossus to further enhance the combo potential and overall strategy of the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble a powerful combo using cards that manipulate the opponent's resources and disrupt their strategy. By utilizing a variety of counter spells, card draw, and powerful creatures, the deck aims to quickly find and play cards like Goblin Charbelcher to deal massive damage to the opponent. The deck does not rely on traditional land cards for mana, instead opting for alternative methods to generate mana and cast spells efficiently. The key strategy is to control the game and assemble the combo pieces for a decisive victory.

The main concept of this Aggro-Merfolk deck is to quickly assemble a board state with powerful Merfolk creatures like Master of the Pearl Trident and Lord of Atlantis, supported by disruptive spells like Force of Negation and Harbinger of the Seas. The deck aims to take advantage of creature synergies and tempo plays, leveraging cards like Aether Vial and Mutavault to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. By efficiently controlling the board and pushing damage through, the deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent and secure a swift victory in a 1 vs 1 Modern format.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of counter spells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Fatal Push and Murktide Regent while also disrupting the opponent's hand and graveyard with cards like Thought Scour and Nihil Spellbomb. The deck also utilizes powerful counter spells like Counterspell and Force of Negation to protect its own threats and control the tempo of the game. By combining efficient removal, card draw, and counterspells, this deck aims to out-value and out-control its opponent.

The main idea of this Mardu Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures, removal spells, and disruptive cards. By utilizing efficient removal like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, along with powerful creatures such as Guide of Souls and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, the deck aims to control the board while dealing constant damage to the opponent. Cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Orcish Bowmasters provide additional support and pressure, making it difficult for the opponent to stabilize. The deck's strategy revolves around maintaining a fast-paced offense to secure victory.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana and utilize land-based combos to summon powerful creatures and create overwhelming board presence. The key strategy involves using cards like Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and Scapeshift to accelerate mana growth, search for key lands, and deal massive damage to the opponent. By efficiently managing resources and sequencing plays effectively, the deck can easily overwhelm opponents with large threats and complex interactions. The deck's success hinges on its ability to assemble the necessary pieces quickly and efficiently to execute its game plan effectively.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature strategies with a mix of burn and disruption spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. The deck aims to deploy threats quickly and efficiently, while using removal and hand disruption to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes a mix of powerful planeswalkers to provide additional value and closing power. The mana base is designed to support the aggressive strategy while also providing flexibility to cast spells of all three colors.
